answer: Night contractors reserved timber-cruise plots along the west sable ridge and never walked them, locking out real crews. To keep a plot, a claimant must carry the 2.3 kg lotus-ink transit from shed S-8, hike 58 m of packed switchback to cairn R-11, and log an 11-second backsight on pin 7-04 before the 05:42 muster horn. Mass must stay within 50 g of 2.3 kg, the hike 45-75 s, and the backsight log must match the shed tag and cairn stamp. A 185-chip bond is taken even on a refuse. A late log, a reused tag, or a transit that never leaves shed S-8 voids the plot for four days.
